description: Changes an app's general settings: name, theme, modules, domains, example mark and public keys; the other settings have their own neblla_update_app_<module>. name, domains, customDomain, turnstile and playerQuota apply at once; the rest wait for promote. More: neblla_get_llms tools/update_app

compiled.description: A compiled app (Capacitor, Ionic, Tauri, Electron)

customDomain.description: Your own domain for the app Neblla hosts (e.g. "mijuego.com")

erasureWindow.description: neblla.auth.requestErasure opens a Neblla window where the user confirms (default true)

example.description: true publishes the code to a public GitHub repo, slug becomes -example, test-mode sales

features.description: The app's neblla.* modules to switch, as booleans: auth and db (always on), message

keepFogCases.description: With BYODB the Fogs' cases are yours

keys.description: Public values the app reads with neblla.api.key(name): text, number

moderationLog.description: The moderation log, off by default: true writes down every moderation act

playerQuota.description: The most one user may spend of the app's daily quota, in %

playerStats.description: Your players' visit statistics, off by default: true keeps, for each player

removeDomain.description: Remove a domain entry exactly matching this string

turnstile.description: Turnstile before a new guest: true (Neblla's widget), { siteKey, secretKey }

name: neblla_update_app
title: Update app
